text:
nina: Heads up — vendor just flagged a partial DOA batch from the last H100 shipment, looks like ~12 units affected. they can RMA and air-replace but ETA is 6-8 business days due to customs in FRA. we have a live pool spike next week.

alex: Ugh. Can you post the vendor AWB and serials when you have them? need to check if any are already in our staging racks.

maria-logistics: Posted the initial manifest in #warehouse but copying summary here. serials 1001–1012 impacted, AWB: XN123456789. carrier says FRA customs clearance window is causing the 6–8bd delay. we can split shipment: air-priority for 6 units (expedite fee) + sea for remainder.

sam-ops: If we lose those 12 H100s we risk dropping throughput on the render/test cluster by ~40%. short-term fallback: roll traffic to quantized A800s (approx -20% perf for our LLM mix) + increase batching. tradeoff: increased latency for tail queries.

jamie-finance: Expedite fee for 6 air replacements is estimated at $9k/unit landed vs $2.6k for standard replace (sea). math: air 54k vs sea 31.2k + multi-day impact on SLA.

alex: @maria-logistics can you confirm insurance coverage for split AWB? last time split caused an invoice mismatch that delayed claim.

maria-logistics: Insurance covers DOA if we submit within 48hrs of receipt. splitting is OK but need two claim lines and two commercial invoices. i can prep the docs, ETA today EOD.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-4021 created for fallback routing + RMA tracking https://redwood.infra/tickets/INF-4021

sam-ops: Proposal: 1) Approve air for 6 (critical pools), 2) Reassign 8 A800s from non-prod to prod with temporary quota bump, 3) Kick automatic cache-warm on affected routes to reduce cold-start impact. Who owns step 2?

nina: I can coordinate with platform to pin the quota bump for 72hrs. @alex please validate A800 perf on the 7B chat workload before we shift.

alex: I'll run a quick perf sweep now. if quantized paths hold 80% of throughput, we should be fine. will report in 45m.

maria-logistics: Shipping note: to do air split we need PO amendment signed by procurement. i pushed a PDF to the vendor drive; procurement has to sign.

jamie-finance: Approving up to $60k in expedite spend for the incident contingent on ops giving a post-mortem and cost allocation to the product line.

sam-ops: Good. I'll schedule a canary rollout on the A800s and add latency alarms for 99.9th pct. if alarms trip, we'll throttle non-critical routes.

nina: Thanks everyone. next steps: maria amend PO + file insurance claim; alex validate perf; sam run canary + update INF-4021; jamie will fund expedite. update thread when AWB split confirmed. :white_check_mark:

maria-logistics: PO amendment signed, vendor confirmed partial AWB split. air AWB: XN123456790 (6 units), sea AWB: XM987654321 (6 units). filing claim now.

alex: Perf sweep: A800 quantized holds ~78% throughput, 95th pct tail latency +120ms. rolling canary now.

ops-bot: INF-4021 updated — air AWB XN123456790 attached, insurance claim filed CLM-7782.

nina: Closing for now, reopening if alarms fire. thanks all. :pray:
